title: THE CORNER CREDITS END WHERE THE HEADING ENDS
why: Seen on the 4K settings screenshot after v19.73: with a window open the CREDITS and XP readout now sits on the heading line, but its XP ran past the end of the heading underline to almost touch the window frame. Its right edge now ends where the heading line ends.
now: With a window open, the credits in the corner end where the window title line ends.

edits.replacement: body:has(.modal.on) #topright{ top:24px; right:33px; }   /* v16.xx: and its right edge ends where the heading line ends, inside the frame */
